trackOrder.heading: Track Your Order
trackOrder.intro: Enter your order number and the phone number used at checkout.

shipping.heading: Shipping
shipping.p1: We currently deliver across Egypt. Shipping cost and estimated delivery time depend on your governorate and are shown at checkout before you place your order.
shipping.p2: Every order is confirmed by phone or WhatsApp before it ships, so please make sure the number you provide at checkout is correct and reachable.
shipping.p3: Payment on delivery is available across Egypt. We also accept InstaPay and Egyptian mobile wallet transfers — both are shown as options at checkout.
shipping.p4: Questions about a specific delivery? Reach us on <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp> and we'll help directly.

returns.heading: Returns & Exchanges
returns.p1: Unworn items in their original condition, with tags attached, can be returned or exchanged within 14 days of delivery.
returns.p2: To start a return or exchange, message us on WhatsApp with your order number and which item you'd like to return — we'll walk you through the next steps from there.
returns.p3Prefix: Items that are worn, washed, altered, or without original tags can't be accepted. Custom or made-to-order pieces from
returns.p4: Questions before you buy? Reach us on <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp> — sizing help included.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.intro: Order questions, sizing help, custom requests, or anything else — WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us.

createYourOwn.heading: Make the silhouette yours.
createYourOwn.body: Want a custom print, your own design, or a one-off hoodie or pair of pants made to spec? We do custom and print-on-demand pieces directly — reach out through any of the channels below and our team will walk you through it.
